source: Greatest-eclipse coordinates cross-checked against NASA Besselian element pages (e.g. https://eclipse.gsfc.nasa.gov/SEsearch/SEdata.php?Ecl=20260812).
attribution: Eclipse Predictions by Fred Espenak, NASA's GSFC
notes: Dates are the UTC calendar date of the instant of greatest eclipse.
Kinds match NASA's decade table: 2026-08-12 total, 2027-02-06 annular, 2027-08-02 total, 2028-01-26 annular, 2028-07-22 total, 2029-01-14 partial.
Latitude/longitude are the greatest-eclipse coordinates (total/annular only; undefined for partials). astronomy-engine values agree with NASA within ~0.1°.

Obscuration is astronomy-engine's greatest-eclipse value (total/annular only); NASA's decade table does not publish obscuration, so this is asserted for self-consistency (it must be 1 for total, <1 for annular).
